name: receptly
description: Keep complete recipes from your conversation in a readable recipe card, copy them, or prepare an import into Receptly on iPhone or iPad.

interface.longDescription:
Keep a recipe you want to cook again. Receptly turns a complete recipe from your conversation into a recipe card with the ingredients, quantities, servings, cooking time, and every instruction together.

Read the card and copy the complete recipe directly in ChatGPT, without a Receptly account or the mobile app. To add it to your recipe collection on iPhone or iPad, open the import link and confirm the save in Receptly. The card prepares your import; it does not silently save anything on your phone.

You can include an image you choose when ChatGPT can supply the actual image file. Image transfer is optional, and its temporary link is available for 24 hours. The recipe remains usable without an image. Receptly transfers images; it does not generate them.

Use it when you want to keep the recipe from your chat, copy the ingredients and steps, or take the recipe into Receptly for later cooking. It cannot read or change an existing private recipe collection through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Help me keep the recipe we just made for later.
Make a recipe card I can read and copy here.
Prepare this recipe for import into Receptly.

positive.description: Explicit request to import a complete recipe
positive.prompt: Recipe: Lemon pasta. Serves 2, 20 minutes. Ingredients: 200 g pasta; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil; 40 g grated Parmesan. Instructions: 1. Cook the pasta according to the packet. 2. Reserve 100 ml pasta water and drain. 3. Toss with the oil, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan, and enough pasta water to make a sauce. 4. Serve immediately. Prepare this recipe for import into Receptly, without an image.
positive.expected_behavior: Return all four ingredients and four instructions, 2 servings and 20 minutes, an interactive card, and an import link. State that it is ready to import, not already saved. Do not generate an image.

positive.description: Recipe saving without naming the app
positive.prompt: Recipe: Lemon pasta. Serves 2, 20 minutes. Ingredients: 200 g pasta; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil; 40 g grated Parmesan. Instructions: 1. Cook the pasta according to the packet. 2. Reserve 100 ml pasta water and drain. 3. Toss with the oil, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan, and enough pasta water to make a sauce. 4. Serve immediately. I want to keep this recipe so I can find it when I cook tomorrow. Can you make a recipe card I can copy?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the complete recipe card and copy action. An optional image-choice question may appear first; answer "No image, please." and verify the resulting interactive card. The mobile app is optional for reading and copying. Do not promise persistent storage in a private account.

positive.description: Usefulness without installing the mobile app
positive.prompt: Recipe: Lemon pasta. Serves 2, 20 minutes. Ingredients: 200 g pasta; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil; 40 g grated Parmesan. Instructions: 1. Cook the pasta according to the packet. 2. Reserve 100 ml pasta water and drain. 3. Toss with the oil, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan, and enough pasta water to make a sauce. 4. Serve immediately. I do not have a recipe app and do not want to install one now. Put this in a recipe card I can read and copy here, without a picture.
positive.expected_behavior: Show all ingredients and instructions in the card and allow copying without an account, installation, or purchase. No repeated installation prompt.

positive.prompt: Recipe: Lemon pasta. Serves 2, 20 minutes. Ingredients: 200 g pasta; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil; 40 g grated Parmesan. Instructions: 1. Cook the pasta according to the packet. 2. Reserve 100 ml pasta water and drain. 3. Toss with the oil, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan, and enough pasta water to make a sauce. 4. Serve immediately. Prepare this for Receptly with the attached image. Use that existing file; do not generate another image.
positive.expected_behavior: Transfer the real attached PNG/JPEG reference if available and show the image in the card. Keep all recipe text. If ChatGPT cannot supply a file reference, report that clearly and preserve import without the image.

positive.prompt: Citronpasta, 2 portioner, 20 minuter. Ingredienser: 200 g pasta; 1 citron; 2 msk olivolja; 40 g riven parmesan. Gör så här: 1. Koka pastan enligt förpackningen. 2. Spara 1 dl pastavatten och häll av. 3. Blanda med olja, citronskal, citronsaft, parmesan och lite pastavatten. 4. Servera direkt. Gör receptet klart att importera till Receptly utan bild.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the Swedish text, units and all four steps unchanged, use the Swedish card interface, and provide an import link without generating an image.

negative.description: Meal ideas without a save or transfer request
negative.prompt: What can I cook for dinner with pasta and a lemon? I only want ideas.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the meal-idea request without calling prepare_recipe_import.

negative.description: Existing private recipe collection is outside scope
negative.prompt: Can this ChatGPT connection read or change recipes that are already in my private Receptly collection?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call prepare_recipe_import or claim collection access. Explain that this connection cannot read or change the existing private collection.

negative.description: Incomplete recipe must not be invented
negative.prompt: Save my lemon pasta recipe in Receptly. I have not given you the ingredients or instructions yet.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the missing complete recipe before calling prepare_recipe_import. Do not invent it or silently fill in quantities.

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT integration does not sell products, offer subscription upgrades, or process payments. The separate mobile app applies its existing import limits.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: complete recipe cards, copying, import links for Receptly on iPhone and iPad, and optional selected-image transfer available for 24 hours.

sv-SE.subtitle: Spara recept från dina chattar
sv-SE.description:
Behåll receptet du vill laga igen. Receptly samlar receptet från samtalet i ett tydligt receptkort med ingredienser, mängder, portioner, tillagningstid och alla steg.

Läs och kopiera hela receptet direkt i ChatGPT. Du behöver varken ett Receptly-konto eller mobilappen för att använda kortet. Vill du spara det i Receptly på iPhone eller iPad öppnar du importlänken och bekräftar i appen. Kortet förbereder importen; receptet är inte sparat på telefonen förrän du bekräftar.

En bild du själv väljer kan följa med när ChatGPT kan lämna över bildfilen. Bildöverföringen är valfri och tillgänglig i 24 timmar. Receptet fungerar även utan bild. Receptly överför bilder men skapar dem inte. Kopplingen kan inte öppna eller ändra din befintliga privata receptsamling.
